paragraphs.en: A single CLAUDE.md file to improve Claude Code behavior, derived from Andrej Karpathy's observations on LLM coding pitfalls.
paragraphs.zh: 一份用于改善 Claude Code 行为的单一 CLAUDE.md 文件，源自 Andrej Karpathy 对大语言模型编码陷阱的观察。

paragraphs.en: Check out my new project Multica — an open-source platform for running and managing coding agents with reusable skills.
paragraphs.zh: 来看看我的新项目 Multica —— 一个开源平台，用于运行和管理具备可复用技能的编码智能体。

paragraphs.en: Follow me on X: https://x.com/jiayuan_jy
paragraphs.zh: 在 X 上关注我：https://x.com/jiayuan_jy

paragraphs.en: "The models make wrong assumptions on your behalf and just run along with them without checking. They don't manage their confusion, don't seek clarifications, don't surface inconsistencies, don't present tradeoffs, don't push back when they should."
paragraphs.zh: “这些模型会替你做出错误的假设，并且不加核实就径直照此执行。 它们不管理自身的困惑，不寻求澄清，不暴露不一致之处，不呈现权衡取舍，也不在该提出异议时提出异议。”

sents.en: "The models make wrong assumptions on your behalf and just run along with them without checking.
sents.zh: “这些模型会替你做出错误的假设，并且不加核实就径直照此执行。

sents.en: They don't manage their confusion, don't seek clarifications, don't surface inconsistencies, don't present tradeoffs, don't push back when they should."
sents.zh: 它们不管理自身的困惑，不寻求澄清，不暴露不一致之处，不呈现权衡取舍，也不在该提出异议时提出异议。”

paragraphs.en: "They really like to overcomplicate code and APIs, bloat abstractions, don't clean up dead code... implement a bloated construction over 1000 lines when 100 would do."
paragraphs.zh: “他们真的很喜欢把代码和 API 过度复杂化，让抽象变得臃肿，也不清理死代码……明明 100 行就够了，却实现了一个超过 1000 行的臃肿结构。”

paragraphs.en: "They still sometimes change/remove comments and code they don't sufficiently understand as side effects, even if orthogonal to the task."
paragraphs.zh: “它们有时仍会在副作用中更改/删除自己没有充分理解的注释和代码，即使这些与任务正交（无关）。”

paragraphs.en: Four principles in one file that directly address these issues:
paragraphs.zh: 一个文件中的四项原则，直接解决这些问题：

paragraphs.en: Don't assume. Don't hide confusion. Surface tradeoffs.
paragraphs.zh: 不要妄下假设。不要掩饰困惑。把权衡摆到明面上。

paragraphs.en: LLMs often pick an interpretation silently and run with it. This principle forces explicit reasoning:
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型常常会默默选定一种理解方式并直接照此执行。 这一原则迫使模型进行显式推理：

sents.en: LLMs often pick an interpretation silently and run with it.
sents.zh: 大语言模型常常会默默选定一种理解方式并直接照此执行。
这一原则迫使模型进行显式推理：

paragraphs.en: Minimum code that solves the problem. Nothing speculative.
paragraphs.zh: 解决问题的最小代码。没有任何投机性的内容。

paragraphs.en: Combat the tendency toward overengineering:
paragraphs.zh: 对抗过度工程化的倾向：

paragraphs.en: The test: Would a senior engineer say this is overcomplicated? If yes, simplify.
paragraphs.zh: 测试标准：一位资深工程师会不会认为这过于复杂？如果是，就进行简化。

paragraphs.en: Touch only what you must. Clean up only your own mess.
paragraphs.zh: 只接触你必须接触的东西。 只清理你自己弄乱的东西。

sents.zh: 只接触你必须接触的东西。

sents.en: Clean up only your own mess.
sents.zh: 只清理你自己弄乱的东西。

paragraphs.en: The test: Every changed line should trace directly to the user's request.
paragraphs.zh: 检验标准：每一行被修改的代码都应能直接追溯到用户的请求。

paragraphs.en: Define success criteria. Loop until verified.
paragraphs.zh: 定义成功标准。循环验证直至通过。

paragraphs.en: Transform imperative tasks into verifiable goals:
paragraphs.zh: 将指令式任务转化为可验证的目标：

paragraphs.en: For multi-step tasks, state a brief plan:
paragraphs.zh: 对于多步骤任务，请先陈述一个简要的计划：

paragraphs.en: 1. [Step] → verify: [check] 2. [Step] → verify: [check] 3. [Step] → verify: [check] Strong success criteria let the LLM loop independently. Weak criteria ("make it work") require constant clarification.
paragraphs.zh: 1. [步骤] → 验证：[检查] 2. [步骤] → 验证：[检查] 3. [步骤] → 验证：[检查] 强大的成功标准能让大语言模型独立循环运行。 模糊的标准（“能用就行”）需要不断澄清。

sents.en: [Step] → verify: [check] Strong success criteria let the LLM loop independently.
sents.zh: [步骤] → 验证：[检查] 强大的成功标准能让大语言模型独立循环运行。

sents.en: Weak criteria ("make it work") require constant clarification.
sents.zh: 模糊的标准（“能用就行”）需要不断澄清。

paragraphs.en: Option A: Claude Code Plugin (recommended)
paragraphs.zh: 选项 A：Claude Code 插件（推荐）

paragraphs.en: From within Claude Code, first add the marketplace:
paragraphs.zh: 在 Claude Code 内部，首先添加市场：

paragraphs.en: /plugin marketplace add forrestchang/andrej-karpathy-skills Then install the plugin:
paragraphs.zh: /plugin marketplace add forrestchang/andrej-karpathy-skills 然后安装插件：

paragraphs.en: /plugin install andrej-karpathy-skills@karpathy-skills This installs the guidelines as a Claude Code plugin, making the skill available across all your projects.
paragraphs.zh: /plugin install andrej-karpathy-skills@karpathy-skills 这会将这些指南作为 Claude Code 插件安装，使该技能在你的所有项目中都可用。

paragraphs.en: "LLMs are exceptionally good at looping until they meet specific goals... Don't tell it what to do, give it success criteria and watch it go."
paragraphs.zh: “大语言模型非常擅长循环执行直到达成特定目标…… 不要告诉它该做什么，给它成功标准，然后看它行动即可。

sents.en: "LLMs are exceptionally good at looping until they meet specific goals...
sents.zh: “大语言模型非常擅长循环执行直到达成特定目标……

sents.en: Don't tell it what to do, give it success criteria and watch it go."
sents.zh: 不要告诉它该做什么，给它成功标准，然后看它行动即可。

paragraphs.en: The "Goal-Driven Execution" principle captures this: transform imperative instructions into declarative goals with verification loops.
paragraphs.zh: 「目标驱动执行」原则正是抓住了这一点：将命令式指令转化为带有验证循环的声明式目标。

sents.zh: 这些指南旨在与项目专属指令合并使用。

sents.en: Add them to your existing CLAUDE.md or create a new one.
sents.zh: 可将其添加到现有的 CLAUDE.md 中，或新建一个。

paragraphs.en: For project-specific rules, add sections like:
paragraphs.zh: 针对项目特定规则，可添加如下章节：

paragraphs.en: ## Project-Specific Guidelines - Use TypeScript strict mode - All API endpoints must have tests - Follow the existing error handling patterns in ` src/utils/errors.ts ` Tradeoff Note These guidelines bias toward caution over speed . For trivial tasks (simple typo fixes, obvious one-liners), use judgment — not every change needs the full rigor.
paragraphs.zh: ## 项目专属规范 - 使用 TypeScript 严格模式 - 所有 API 端点必须有测试 - 遵循 ` src/utils/errors.ts ` 中现有的错误处理模式 权衡说明 这些规范偏向谨慎而非速度。 对于琐碎任务（简单的拼写修正、显而易见的单行修改），请自行判断——并非每次改动都需要完整的严格流程。

sents.en: ## Project-Specific Guidelines - Use TypeScript strict mode - All API endpoints must have tests - Follow the existing error handling patterns in ` src/utils/errors.ts ` Tradeoff Note These guidelines bias toward caution over speed .
sents.zh: ## 项目专属规范 - 使用 TypeScript 严格模式 - 所有 API 端点必须有测试 - 遵循 ` src/utils/errors.ts ` 中现有的错误处理模式 权衡说明 这些规范偏向谨慎而非速度。

sents.en: For trivial tasks (simple typo fixes, obvious one-liners), use judgment — not every change needs the full rigor.
sents.zh: 对于琐碎任务（简单的拼写修正、显而易见的单行修改），请自行判断——并非每次改动都需要完整的严格流程。

paragraphs.en: The goal is reducing costly mistakes on non-trivial work, not slowing down simple tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 目标是减少非琐碎工作中代价高昂的错误，而不是拖慢简单任务。
